headers._comment: ONLY /assets/** is content-hashed by Vite, so only it may be immutable. The old **/*.@(js|css|...) glob also matched the UNHASHED root files (landing.js, site-meta.js, sw-register.js, termly-embed.js), pinning them in browser caches for a year — a stale landing page with no way to push a fix.
Icons are unhashed but change very rarely — a month is the compromise.

The /api/** rewrites are matched by the catch-all ** block above, whose no-cache would defeat the CDN caching the flat-cost model depends on. These blocks come LAST (later match wins) and MIRROR the TTLs the function already sets on each response — so the header is correct no matter which layer wins.
